configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native (SDL2, all 5 renderers) -- the WASM twin / compat oracle, one binary
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build (needs a 32-bit SDL2). Builds the full renderer set with no -D flags: NOpenGLESDrv + XOpenGLDrv + OpenGLDrv/UTGLR (system GL) + SoftDrv + NullDrv (2.12.0 sensible defaults). BUILD_STATIC links every package into ONE UnrealTournament -- no Core.so/Engine.so beside it, and appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal UNREAL_STATIC registry instead of dlopen (ufront 2.34; system libs SDL2/OpenAL/libGL stay dynamic). NOpenGLES and XOpenGL co-link in that single binary because Thirdparty/glad_es now carries a private symbol prefix -- keeping the compat oracle intact through the switch. Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: native64
configurePresets.description: 64-bit (LP64) native build: the same one-binary package set as `native`, compiled for x86_64 instead of -m32. Needs the amd64 SDL2 development files (libsdl2-dev) for the client; ucc-bin needs no SDL, GL or audio. Retail 32-bit .u packages run unchanged: script object references stay 4-byte slots holding the object index, and the reflected-class headers are pack(4) (ufront docs/migration/steps/2.83-64bit-ue1.md). Builds in build-native64/.

configurePresets.name: native64-asan
configurePresets.description: native64 with -fsanitize=address. Run with ASAN_OPTIONS=alloc_dealloc_mismatch=0 (UE1's sized operator delete pairing is reported but benign). Put the binary in the run tree's System/ itself: the engine takes its base dir from the executable path. Builds in build-native64-asan/.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64-ucc
configurePresets.description: The dedicated server and commandlets as one Android executable (no SDL, no renderer, no audio, no APK): the 64-bit engine on an ARM device, run from adb shell. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME (e.g. ~/Android/Sdk/ndk/30.0.14904198). Builds in build-android-arm64/.

configurePresets.name: android-armv7-ucc
configurePresets.displayName: Android armv7 -- headless ucc-bin only, the 32-bit control (ufront 2.83)
configurePresets.description: The same headless ucc-bin for armeabi-v7a: the 32-bit width control on the same ARM device. Builds in build-android-armv7/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions. The everyday dev build — named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source <emsdk>/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the OPTIMISER is the suspect — a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build (-O3, no debug -> smaller/faster). Builds in build-wasm-perf/. [wired in step 2.7b]

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build. Cross-compiles from Linux via the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 + a fetched SDL2); the SAME preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt, where pacman's SDL2 answers instead. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe — no Core.dll/Engine.dll, and appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal registry, not LoadLibrary. Renderers: UTGLR (OpenGLDrv) + XOpenGLDrv, both hardware GL through the system opengl32 (they resolve every entry point via SDL_GL_GetProcAddress, so nothing GL ships beside the exe), plus SoftDrv + NullDrv (CPU-only, so the build still verifies headless under wine+Xvfb). NOpenGLESDrv is OFF here: it and XOpenGL vendor clashing glad globals in a non-Emscripten static link. Audio is the REAL NOpenALDrv (OpenAL Soft + libxmp), whose OpenAL32.dll the build copies next to the exe — a silent binary is not a usable default. [ufront 2.33, renderers + audio 2.34] BUILD_EDITOR is ON for the same reason the web build sets it: UT99 loads bot meshes/skins through Editor classes, so standalone bot matches abort without it. Builds in build-windows/.
